About

Located within the luxurious Wavez by Danube building in Liwan, Sai Beauty Salon Liwan delivers an exquisite blend of beauty services designed to pamper you and make you feel brand new. From meticulous manicures and pedicures to revitalizing hair treatments and soothing massages, every service reflects a commitment to quality and care. Proudly woman-owned and environmentally friendly, this salon embraces any approach to beauty, ensuring that clients leave feeling radiant and refreshed.
